+async fn list_skills(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> Result<Json<Value>, ApiError> {
+    let snapshot = state.skills.snapshot(None).await;
+    serde_json::to_value(snapshot)
+        .map(Json)
+        .map_err(ApiError::internal)
+}
+
+async fn get_skill(
+    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
+    Path(name): Path<String>,
+) -> Result<Json<Value>, ApiError> {
+    let skill = state
+        .skills
+        .get(&name, None)
+        .await
+        .map_err(ApiError::internal)?
+        .ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found(format!("skill {name:?} not found")))?;
+    serde_json::to_value(skill)
+        .map(Json)
+        .map_err(ApiError::internal)
+}
